title: Technostress in the Age of AI: A Preliminary Study with Software Professionals
abstract: arXiv:2609.15686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid adoption and evolution of AI are changing software engineering work and requiring professionals to repeatedly adapt their knowledge, practices, and skills. Although technological adaptation has long characterized software development, less is known about how these new and recurring pressures manifest as technostress. This preliminary exploratory study investigates AI related technostress among software professionals. We conducted a survey and performed a thematic analysis of responses from 121 software professionals across 26 countries reporting their recent experiences with AI at work. Our findings suggest that AI related technostress emerges not only from adapting to rapidly changing technologies, but also from having to manage the work, technical responsibilities, and professional changes that accompany their adoption. translated_title: 人工智能时代的技术压力：针对软件专业人员的一项初步研究
translated_abstract: 人工智能的快速采用和演进正在改变软件工程工作，要求专业人员不断调整他们的知识、实践和技能。尽管技术适应长期以来一直是软件开发的特征，但人们对这些新的、反复出现的压力如何表现为技术压力知之甚少。这项初步探索性研究调查了软件专业人员中与人工智能相关的技术压力。我们开展了一项调查研究，并对来自26个国家的121名软件专业人员所报告的近期工作中使用人工智能经历的回复进行了主题分析。我们的研究结果表明，与人工智能相关的技术压力不仅源于对快速变化技术的适应，还源于必须管理与人工智能采用相伴随的工作、技术职责和职业变化。这一特征表明，人工智能带来的压力超出了学习和使用新工具的范畴，影响着……
tldr: 通过对26个国家121名软件专业人员的调查发现，AI相关的技术压力不仅源于适应快速变化的技术，还源于必须管理随之而来的工作、技术职责和职业变化。
en_tdlr: This preliminary study of 121 software professionals across 26 countries reveals that AI-related technostress stems not only from adapting to rapidly changing technologies but also from managing the accompanying work, technical responsibilities, and professional changes.
